Accessment of our current NFT strategy 
    - Consider subscription model by player to get TSD on a regular interval at a discounted price

Accessment of our current NFT strategy 
    - Raise the issue of PFP NFT as an indicator of good trader if it can be resold

Accessment of our current NFT strategy 
    - Suggested the issue of Mutant Potion for high performances to enjoy bonuses in our game

Accessment of our current NFT strategy 
    - Remove acheiving specific status before qualifying to mint PFP NFT, otherwise NFT might not get sold out.

Accessment of what is a good quality NFT project

    - Fully Doxxed team that is fully transparent and competent
    - Day 1 utility (not the milestone game of at x % this and x % that)
    - Give back (charity, community,…)
    - Culture in their discord server (value vs. hype, good conversations, not just LFG and WAGMI spam chats), a professional and active community where the newest member in the room is the most important member in the room. The community should have a growth-mindset based culture, not just chasing the money
    - Real life benefits (not just metaverse gadgets)
    - (Personal events)
    - Artwork should be good enough to hang on my
    - Differentiated from other projects
Go To Market: Mass adoption will come slowly. For the NFT mint we should focus on people already in the space bc of the high barrier of entry.

Sample minting page: 
https://mint.metamansionsbykeys.com/
https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/blob/main/assets/20220318_anika_minting_page.png

NFT initiative roadmap and strategy:
    - Offer NFT minting at phase 3 of our roadmap after our game has been solidified
    - She will find artist from NFTAcademy to create artwork and design 
    - need to have 8 - 10 people on the team
    - Launch NFT based on refined tokenomics
    - Need to find moderators who are willing to volunteer for a project if they like it in hopes that they eventually become core contributors and get paid
    - Royalty fees of NFT resale should go to some selected charities

NFT artistic direction:
    - Just keep Collection #2 Player Profile Picture ( Alien Civilization )
    - Scrape Collection #1 Coin of Truth (Unlikely to sell well)
    - Scrape Collection #3 Alien Evolution (Too complicated)

NFT artistic direction:
    - Main Choice: the 5 types of profile pictures should represent 5 different races. Each race's profile picture should have small subtle variables which ties to off chain benefits (Holding wine glass or SnowBoard which gives access to VIP events)
    - Secondary Choice: the 5 types of profile pictures should either be having the same base like Cheetah
Gamification: blue check mark on the NFT itself to indicate very very strong trader
TSD airdrops should still continue for NFT holders for it to continue retaining its value.
NFT concept design: Need to keep the art neutral so that everyone can participate. So we shall avoid using religious symbols
NFT benefit extension: Introduce a Joker NFT which can go to all events
NFT benefit idea: Sell an NFT which gives a chance to receive substantial amounts of Ethereum so that people will hold and not flip

NFT benefit idea: People can play game to level up NFT so as to increase its rarity. Problem is after a while people will figure they won't be able to achieve that level so they will sell and the floor price will tank
NFT marketing idea: Give people points based on their level of chatting in the Discord group. They can then get whitelisted and gain access to minting special NFTs

NFT benefit design: People demand utility on Day One.

The Game Changer movement Academy is already is very valuable before there was an NFT - It is a Forbes Featured academy
NFT marketing idea: Twitter Space is becoming very popular for evangelizing NFTs. People in the NFT space are really open and easily reachable via Twitter
NFT marketing idea: People might not care as much about the utility at first but then social cause might be what attracted them at first
NFT charity tie up suggestion: Ocean conservation
NFT charity tie up suggestion: Plant Trees: https://www.wilderness-international.org/

NFT artistic direction: Acceptance of collaboration by artist that has blade runner style https://discord.com/channels/@me/949964364675416125/955230228551204904

NFT artistic direction: Acceptance of collaborate by Monkey Tattoo artist
NFT Minting early Access: Restrict minting to just 10 NFTs per wallet so that there are 4500 NFTs left for the wider community

NFT Minting early Access: Have a second white list so that new members might work their way up to gain early access to minting

A whitelist is a list of wallet addresses cleared to mint. You'd simply create a second list with additional wallet addresses that will be allowed to mint at a different time (same day or other day). I think the lists have to be implemented into the smart contract. A developer will know.

Of course the second list would only be allowed to mint after the first list.

NFT Minting early Access: 
NFT Academy suggests minting in several batches. 
I think they said 1 for WL, 
then small public batch to see how the public reacts, when minting is slow, you can hold off the last batch, revamp the marketing campaign until people are fired up, 
then release the rest of the NFTs for public sale. But of course you can do two WL instead of one. 

i've seen projects to even three whitelists, but found that a bit odd.

NFT Minting early access:
just don't make them spend 80 hours grinding in your discord to level up with xp
I hate projects that do that. Result is a spammed chat where people just post bs like WAGMI and LFG
We also can't do many WL giveaways bc then you get a lot of people who might not be all that interested in minting
Gamification: You can give them a king discord role and add a crown to their name

Gamification: You can change the color of the top performing  member names based on their role and add emojis to it. 
In the cheetah discord all whale holders have a whale next to their name. and killer whales like me are orange. so everyone who sees me chat, knows immediately that I'm cheetah royalty. 😉

narrative.text: Anika Giftge contributed to the DAO's Build Game efforts from March 2022 to April 2022, focusing primarily on strategy development through reference materials, idea applications, reviews, and improvements. She brought on passive observers twice and a key opinion leader once under Bring Builders. Her contributions include reviewing proposed strategies to suggest against actions or highlight watch areas, independently reiterating pending decision signals, providing UX suggestions, and linking reference materials. Notable was onboarding a key opinion leader.
